text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ah, come on! Where is everyone?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spot Bamboo Memory in the hallway
looking
unusually disturbed.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well... the disciplinary committee has a
meeting
scheduled today, but not
everyone has shown up
yet! And we've
had a lot of important things to
cover
recently!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Like how too many students are bringing
personal
items to class! And improving
our efforts to get
everyone to stop
sleeping during morning
practice!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Or whether or not we should be holding
seminars
on how to speak to crows so we
can keep them
off the crops! We're not
going to be able to talk
about any of
this at this rate!

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member A
text_block_list.text: Bamboo! I found everyone! F-follow me!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
There you all are! Let's hurry up and
start the
mee—

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Members
text_block_list.text:
No! We've had it! We've worked hard
enough,
and we want the day off!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Do you have any idea what you're
saying?! Why
are you acting so childish?!

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Members
text_block_list.text:
Tell her, Mom! We've been working so
hard,
right?! We deserve a break, right?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! ♪ Of course you do, since
you're all so
wonderful! Go ahead and
take a rest! ♪

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
C-Creek?! What the heck are you doing
here?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: What do you mean? We're all just—

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
All right, that does it for patrolling the
school!
Phew... I'm beat!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! ♪ You've been working so hard,
haven't
you? Why not take a little
break? I have some
delicious tea and
snacks for you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member C
text_block_list.text: Hey! Heeey! Sigh... Where'd she go? She should be finished patrolling by now...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh! ♪ How lovely! You came looking for
your
friend! You deserve a special
reward for being
such a good girl! ♪

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member B
text_block_list.text: Yay! Let's share these cookies!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...And everyone else showed up while we
were at
it. So we've been relaxing and
enjoying each
other's company.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh, everyone... You were all really that
tired? I
had no idea!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I'm sorry, everyone! I take full

responsibility... And now, I'll reawaken
your sense
of discipline!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Repeat after me! The five tenets of the

disciplinary committee are...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
One! A lax mentality leads to lax
discipline!
Two! Instruct with red-hot
passion, but also love!
Three!
Rule-breaking shall not be tolerated!

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Members
text_block_list.text:
...?
Hrmph?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Four! Dreams shall not be tread upon!

Five! Guide troublemakers 24/7/365!

One! A lax mentality...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory recites the tenets at
the top of
her voice over and over until
she begins losing her
voice.

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
A lax mentality... leads to... lax
discipline!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's right! We're the ones who help
everyone
keep their school life safe and
sound! We must
remember that!

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Members
text_block_list.text:
I-instruct with passion, but also... love!

Three... Rule breaking shall... not be
tolerated...
Four! Dreams shall... not be
tread upon!

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Ch-Chair! What's happening to
me?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness, everyone! You've
reawakened
your disciplinary spirit!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Creek! Our
committee is in
your debt! Thank you for
everything!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are we already finished? That's too
bad... I've
got futons prepared in case
anyone needs a nap...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I just can't believe I didn't notice how
everyone
was feeling... What an
unacceptable oversight for
the head of
the disciplinary committee!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I just can't believe I didn't notice how
everyone
was feeling... What an
unacceptable oversight for
the head of
the disciplinary committee!

Why not study how your great seniors do things?

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member A
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Let's remember why we joined the

committee in the first place and get
back to work!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! Discipline committee!
Formation
A!

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Members
text_block_list.text:
Aye-aye! Presenting the "Disciplinary

Committee's Hype Pose!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! You're all so neat and orderly!

Beautiful! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, the disciplinary committee
has an
earnest discussion amongst
themselves, and they
all become more
unified.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hm, that's a good point! Thanks to
Creek,
everyone is looking really
refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hey, Creek! I have a favor to ask you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Do you think you could throw one of
your
pampering parties so I can watch
and learn how
you do it?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Could I?! I'd be more than happy
to! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm a bit worried, but I suppose this will help the disciplinary committee solve all the problems they've been dealing with... maybe.
